Name: PelicanCardClub
Author: s1enderrr77
Description:
[size=5][b]Pelican Card Club[/b][/size]
[i]鹈鹕镇牌友会 - Phone your friends in Pelican Town and invite them over for a game of Dou Dizhu (Fight the Landlord)![/i]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Phone invitations[/b] - Dial the new "Card Club" number on your telephone (or right-click the card table), pick a time and two villagers, and call them.[/*]
[*][b]Real schedules[/b] - The phone book shows who's free, who's at work and when their shift ends, based on that villager's actual schedule for the day (rain, days off and festivals included).[/*]
[*][b]Villagers decide for themselves[/b] - Friendship and personality decide whether they say yes. Close friends who are working may come after their shift, or even take time off for you. Homebodies skip rainy days, kids can't stay out late, and birthdays are special.[/*]
[*][b]House calls[/b] - At the agreed time your guests knock on the door and gather around the card table. Not home? They'll wait at the door for a while. Guests who wait too long make their own call: back to work if they're on shift, home if they're not.[/*]
[*][b]Full Dou Dizhu rules[/b] - Three players, bidding 1-3 points, every standard combination (straights, pairs chains, planes with wings, four-with-two, bombs, rocket), bomb and spring multipliers. Includes a Hint button and drag-to-select.[/*]
[*][b]Personality-driven AI[/b] - Seven personalities (cheerful, competitive, cool, gentle, intellectual, elder, child) change how villagers bid, when they bomb and how often they slip up. Maru plays sharp; Vincent... not so much.[/*]
[*][b]Table talk[/b] - Villagers chat, tease and react as they play, with changing portraits. Many villagers have their own lines.[/*]
[*][b]Small bets[/b] - When you call it a night, the lowest scorer gives the highest scorer a gift. Clint pays in ore, Linus in forage, Gus in pizza and beer. If you lose, pick something from your bag (gift tastes apply), pay in gold, or put it on your tab.[/*]
[*][b]Friendship[/b] - Every hand builds friendship (with a daily cap).[/*]
[*][b]Saloon music[/b] while you play.[/*]
[*][b]Card table[/b] - Gus mails you one; Robin also sells it.[/*]
[*][b]Full English and Chinese[/b] translations.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5+[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in game[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI, unzip this mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Check your mailbox the next morning - Gus sends a card table. Place it in your farmhouse.[/*]
[*]Use your telephone and call the "Card Club", or right-click the card table.[/*]
[*]Choose a time and two villagers, then call.[/*]
[*]When everyone has arrived, right-click the table and start.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
End time (default midnight), minutes per hand, table UI size, AI speed, chatter on/off, friendship per hand / win bonus / daily cap, stood-up penalty, accept chance, hearts needed to come after work or take time off, guest patience, small bets on/off, gold per point, card night music, table price.

[size=4][b]Custom NPCs[/b][/size]
Every villager you can befriend works. NPCs without a profile get a personality guessed from their game data. Profiles (personality, skill, work hours, bet gifts...) live in [i]assets/villagers.json[/i] and can also be edited with Content Patcher via [i]Mods/Qupidolove.PelicanCardClub/Villagers[/i]. Levi and Caleb already have profiles.

[size=4][b]Compatibility & notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single player for now. In multiplayer only the host can host card nights. Co-op tables are planned.[/*]
[*]Villagers stand beside the table (no sitting animation yet).[/*]
[*]Coming later: Mahjong and Guandan.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Also by me[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55344]Spouse Homemaker[/url] - your spouse cooks and decorates the farmhouse using items from shared chests.

[line]

[size=5][b]鹈鹕镇牌友会[/b][/size]
用电话约镇上的村民来家里打斗地主！

[size=4][b]功能[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]电话邀约[/b]：电话里多了“牌友会”，也可以对着牌桌右键。选时间、选两位村民，打电话。[/*]
[*][b]按真实日程[/b]：电话本显示谁空闲、谁在上班、几点下班，按村民当天的日程判断（下雨、休息日、节日都算）。[/*]
[*][b]村民自己决定[/b]：好感和性格决定答不答应。关系好的人在上班时可能下班后赶来，甚至请假过来；不爱出门的人下雨天不来，小孩不能太晚，生日也有特别反应。[/*]
[*][b]上门[/b]：到点村民会敲门进来，围到牌桌旁。你不在家就在门口等。等太久了自己决定：要上班的回去上班，不上班的回家。[/*]
[*][b]完整斗地主[/b]：叫分制，顺子、连对、飞机带翅膀、四带二、炸弹、王炸、春天都有。有提示按钮，可以拖动连选。[/*]
[*][b]性格化电脑[/b]：开朗、好胜、冷淡、温和、理性、长辈、小孩七种性格，叫分胆量、用炸弹的时机、失误率都不一样。[/*]
[*][b]打牌时说话[/b]：村民会聊天、嘲讽、报单，头像跟着换表情，很多村民有专属台词。[/*]
[*][b]小赌[/b]：散场时积分最低的送积分最高的一样东西。克林特送矿石，莱纳斯送野菜，格斯送披萨和啤酒；你输了可以从背包里挑（按礼物喜好反应）、给钱，或者先记账。[/*]
[*][b]加好感[/b]：每局都加，每天有上限。[/*]
[*][b]酒吧音乐[/b]伴奏。[/*]
[*][b]牌桌[/b]：格斯会寄一张，罗宾的店里也有卖。[/*]
[*]完整中英文。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]需要[/b][/size]
星露谷 1.6.15+，SMAPI 4.5+。可选：Generic Mod Config Menu（游戏内改设置）。

[size=4][b]说明[/b][/size]
目前只支持单人模式，联机时只有房主能约牌局。麻将、掼蛋会在后续版本加入。自定义 NPC 都能约，没有设定的会按游戏数据自动猜性格；Levi 和夏以昼已经写好了专属设定。
